name: Drive profitable revenue growth
description: Expand top-line sales while protecting and improving net profitability through optimized pricing, fulfillment, and product mix.
executive_questions: Is our revenue growth translating into sustainable profit expansion?
sub_questions: Is growth driven by volume or price increases?
Are fulfillment costs eroding margins as we scale?
Which product categories or segments are diluting profitability?
Are discounts being applied efficiently to drive incremental sales?

kpis.name: Net Profit Growth Rate
kpis.description: Measures the period-over-period change in net profit, indicating whether revenue expansion is financially sustainable.
kpis.measurement: Percentage change in sum(Profit) compared to the prior equivalent period (e.g., MoM or QoQ)

operational_metrics.name: Gross Margin Delta
operational_metrics.description: Tracks changes in inherent product profitability before fulfillment costs.
operational_metrics.measurement: Percentage change in mean(Product Base Margin) compared to the prior equivalent period

operational_metrics.name: Shipping Cost Ratio Shift
operational_metrics.description: Reveals whether fulfillment expenses are growing faster or slower than sales.
operational_metrics.measurement: Percentage change in sum(Shipping Cost) / sum(Sales) compared to the prior equivalent period

operational_metrics.name: Discount Impact Delta
operational_metrics.description: Shows how changes in discounting strategy affect net profitability.
operational_metrics.measurement: Percentage change in mean(Discount) compared to the prior equivalent period

kpis.name: Sales Volume Growth Rate
kpis.description: Tracks the period-over-period change in total sales revenue, indicating market demand and commercial momentum.
kpis.measurement: Percentage change in sum(Sales) compared to the prior equivalent period (e.g., MoM or QoQ)

operational_metrics.name: Order Volume Change
operational_metrics.description: Measures the change in the number of distinct transactions driving revenue.
operational_metrics.measurement: Percentage change in count_distinct(Order ID) compared to the prior equivalent period

operational_metrics.name: Average Quantity per Order Shift
operational_metrics.description: Indicates whether revenue growth is driven by larger basket sizes or more transactions.
operational_metrics.measurement: Percentage change in mean(Quantity ordered new) compared to the prior equivalent period

operational_metrics.name: Unit Price Trend
operational_metrics.description: Shows whether revenue growth is supported by pricing power or volume discounts.
operational_metrics.measurement: Percentage change in mean(Unit Price) compared to the prior equivalent period

name: Optimize fulfillment efficiency
description: Reduce delivery lead times and shipping costs while maintaining service levels to protect margins and customer satisfaction.
executive_questions: Are we fulfilling orders faster and more cost-effectively over time?
sub_questions: Which regions or ship modes are driving longer lead times?
Is shipping cost per order increasing or decreasing?
Are express shipments disproportionately impacting profitability?
How does fulfillment speed correlate with order priority?

kpis.name: Fulfillment Lead Time Reduction
kpis.description: Measures the period-over-period decrease in average days between order placement and shipment.
kpis.measurement: Percentage change in mean(days between Order Date and Ship Date) compared to the prior equivalent period

operational_metrics.name: Express Ship Mode Share
operational_metrics.description: Tracks the proportion of orders using faster, typically costlier shipping methods.
operational_metrics.measurement: Percentage change in count_distinct(Order ID) where Ship Mode='Express Air' / total count_distinct(Order ID) compared to the prior equivalent period

operational_metrics.name: Shipping Cost per Order Delta
operational_metrics.description: Reveals whether average fulfillment expense per transaction is improving or deteriorating.
operational_metrics.measurement: Percentage change in sum(Shipping Cost) / count_distinct(Order ID) compared to the prior equivalent period

operational_metrics.name: High Priority Order Fulfillment Rate
operational_metrics.description: Shows whether critical orders are being processed and shipped within target timeframes.
operational_metrics.measurement: Percentage change in mean(days between Order Date and Ship Date) for Order Priority='High' compared to the prior equivalent period

name: Strengthen customer segment performance
description: Identify and capitalize on high-value customer segments to drive repeat purchases and improve lifetime value.
executive_questions: Are we growing revenue and profit from our most valuable customer segments?
sub_questions: Which segments are driving the majority of profit growth?
Are discount strategies aligned with segment purchasing power?
Is customer concentration increasing or diversifying?
How does segment performance vary by region?

kpis.name: Segment Profit Contribution Growth
kpis.description: Tracks the period-over-period change in profit generated by key customer segments.
kpis.measurement: Percentage change in sum(Profit) grouped by Customer Segment compared to the prior equivalent period

operational_metrics.name: Corporate Segment Sales Growth
operational_metrics.description: Measures revenue momentum specifically within the Corporate customer segment.
operational_metrics.measurement: Percentage change in sum(Sales) where Customer Segment='Corporate' compared to the prior equivalent period

operational_metrics.name: Customer Retention Proxy
operational_metrics.description: Indicates whether existing customers are maintaining or increasing their order frequency.
operational_metrics.measurement: Percentage change in count_distinct(Customer ID) with >1 order in current period vs prior period

operational_metrics.name: Segment Discount Sensitivity
operational_metrics.description: Shows how discounting impacts sales volume across different customer segments.
operational_metrics.measurement: Percentage change in mean(Discount) where Customer Segment='Corporate' compared to the prior equivalent period
